messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: CRITICAL service=inference-embeddings-eu
incident details: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PDT1234567

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident #PDT1234567 auto-created and routed to on-call.

Ava Patel: Acked. I'm on it — joining bridge now. First glance: spike of 502/504s on /v1/embeddings ingest in eu-west-1.

Rohan Singh: Ack. I'll take routing/fallback and try to isolate model-level issues. Ava, can you check dedicated pool health and any OOMs?

Priya Malik: On-call check: do we have customer-impact numbers? Any SLA violations yet? @support-team FYI.

Ava Patel: Looking at node logs: repeated OOMs on gpu-node-12 and high GC churn. Kv-cache evictions spiked ~18:42 UTC. Running emergency scale: `./scripts/scale_dedicated.sh --pool embeddings-eu --delta 2`

opsbot: autoscaler: scale request submitted for pool=embeddings-eu, delta=+2, request_id=scale-0x9f1a. Estimated add time ~120s.

Rohan Singh: Adding a temporary routing rule to divert new embeddings traffic to fallback model to reduce pressure:
```
redwood route update --service embeddings --match region=eu-west-1 --fallback-model embed-small-v2 --priority emergency
```

Priya Malik: Support note: error spikes correspond to ~1.8% of customer requests over the last 5m (sampled). Customers seeing 5xx. Sending an interim status to affected customers. @support-team take over comms, link to incident PD.

Ava Patel: Confirmed after scale request: gpu-node-12 is being drained by k8s, pods rescheduling. KV cache warmup ongoing. Errors trending down but still some 502s from older pods.

Rohan Singh: Routing rule applied, traffic shifted for new sessions. Error rate dropped to 0.6% in the last 60s. Monitoring tail latencies and 5xx.

Priya Malik: Good. Please keep timeline notes. Ava, can you draft a 1-2 sentence customer blurb I can paste into support thread?

Ava Patel: Draft: "We experienced a temporary capacity shortage in our eu-west-1 embeddings pool which caused intermittent 5xx errors for a small percentage of requests. We scaled capacity and applied a temporary routing fallback; request success rates have returned to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a post-incident summary."

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: Incident acknowledged by Ava Patel. Status: mitigating. Escalation: none.

Rohan Singh: I'll follow up with autoscaler tuning/thresholds in postmortem. Likely adjust k8s pod memory requests + scale sensitivity for embed-heavy traffic.

Ava Patel: Will keep monitoring for 10m stable window then propose close. Marking as in-progress in the runbook. :thumbsup:

support-team: Received — posting interim status to customers now.

Ava Patel: final check: errors steady <0.5% for last 5m. If stays stable we'll close in 10m and file RCA.

Priya Malik: Thanks team. Good ops.

Ava Patel: closing timeline note: 18:41 UTC alert -> 18:43 scale triggered -> 18:45 routing fallback applied -> 18:52 errors <0.5%

incident-bot: Incident PDT1234567 status updated: mitigating -> monitoring.

Ava Patel: Leaving a short follow-up doc in /incidents/2026/PD1234567. Will assign postmortem owners.
